capabilities: Publish a note to MBlog via a right-click command
Configure the MBlog API token in plugin settings
Map frontmatter fields (title, link, pubDate, tags, draft) to post metadata
extras: README is written in Chinese. The MBlog API is a paid feature, so free MBlog users cannot use this plugin. Only single-article publishing is supported so far.
problem: Obsidian has no built-in way to send notes to the MBlog platform, so publishing a note there requires leaving the vault.

relations.evidence: Obsidian的MBlog平台插件,目前支持发布单篇文章到MBlog

summary: Publishes single Obsidian notes as articles to the MBlog blogging platform through its API, using frontmatter for post metadata.
